arguments.message: Hi! It sounds like the custom domain hasn’t finished verifying yet. After you add the CNAME and TXT records, Meridian checks the domain automatically. The check can take a while because it depends on your DNS provider’s propagation time. On the Custom domain settings page you’ll see a “Pending” or “Verified” status. If it’s still pending, double‑check that both records are correct and give it a bit more time. Once the status turns verified, the certificate should be issued and the error will disappear.
